# Recovery obligations of GUN-1037 that had no asserting test on main: a rewind's edit and a Discarded write each stay in the local trash until retention ends (driver), an overwrite after a Keep replaces the kept write on every device (sim), an answer whose commit a concurrent child move refuses is asked again and then changes only the answered folder (engine against SpaceDo), a split delete keeps every ancestor of an excluded file across reloads (engine), a result lost before the log is truncated is applied once (sim), and an unanswered question is asked again under its own id after restarts (driver and FFI). The #13 test needs a full server setup with two devices, which is most of the size. Review round 1 added mutant witnesses: a reclaim just before the seven-day cutoff, the re-ask read while the session runs, and a resend of the kept version that must come back Superseded.
